description: Ingestion boundary v1 core. Strict numeric parsing (A5/C4): values crossing the boundary parse strictly or quarantine — thousands separators, decimal commas, currency forms, scientific notation, booleans and non-finite numbers are named quarantine reasons, never coerced. The nz()-style fallback is legal only for fields explicitly declared optional and genuinely missing. Plausibility bounds on every quantity-bearing field; the deliveries bounds-guard returns the full A5 substitution plan (quarantined value, trailing-7-day-mean baseline from valid entries only, DATA_HEALTH task, UI banner naming the substitution). Normalization stage (C1/C2): unit spellings resolve against the injected tenant catalog — unresolved spellings raise data-health, never guesses; openPO waiting quantities convert to planning units at ingestion with MISSING/INVALID_CONVERSION_FACTOR refusals before the engine sees rows; money normalizes to tenant currency at ingestion (documentCurrency + tenantValue at the pinned usdToLocal rate; third currencies refused per Decision 7 local↔USD-only; unpinned days refuse RATE_NOT_PINNED; tenantCurrency is mandatory). Pure core: file IO, upserts, RLS and idempotency land with the M1 pipeline stages in the app layer.
